notes: Corrects the latest 270909 Omni-token record's previously-null reward identities. Warcraft Wiki Kirana lists Tier 36 token offers; Method (2026-08-10) confirms a Slumbering Coil Curio may be exchanged for any five Venomous Abyss tier slots; Wowhead item 270909 shows 20 'Currency for' results; one Curio per choice is explicitly stated by Icy Veins. The 20 base item IDs and class families are cross-checked with the existing source-linked research/v3/evidence/midnight/2026-10-30T2208-tier36-token-rewards.jsonl (the prior 20 Tier 36 token identity records). listComplete=true means the 20 BASE Tier 36 token identities (4 armor groups x 5 slots), not exact difficulty-specific bonus versions or 13-class finished item links. Only an eligible armor group is redeemable by an individual character. Method guide text inconsistently calls the vendor Ki'rula, while its waypoint and current item/wiki say Kirana. No new live client vendor snapshot or linked output bonus string was observed. No processing casts, yields or drop rates; do not count these vendor identity records as drop studies.
